result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in the UK, I'd shortlist **DocuSign, Signable and Dropbox Sign**\. However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, how many people need access, and whether you need anything beyond collecting signatures.

My overall recommendation would be **Signable for a small UK business wanting affordable, straightforward e-signatures**, or **DocuSign if you want a widely recognised platform with room to grow**\.

## Best e-signature software compared

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Signable**

(Best for small UK businesses)

- UK-based provider.
- Unlimited users on its account-based plans.
- Pay-as-you-go option.
- Templates, reminders and audit trails.
- Particularly attractive for smaller teams.

Indicative pricing: around £31/month for 50 envelopes.

[Visit Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall)

- Very widely recognised.
- Excellent integrations.
- Document templates and automated workflows.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.
- Strong tracking and audit trails.

Indicative pricing: from around £8/month; business plans cost more.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for simplicity)

- Very easy to use.
- Straightforward signing process.
- Templates and signature requests.
- Good Dropbox integration.
- Suitable for freelancers and small teams.

Indicative pricing: from around £12/month.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![How to Use PandaDoc - Getting Started Guide (2026) | Delv](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/WruE4vK3FXwhwa4g9TWNHGu1eO8aHIUdnm0spwRmxEwf0jqDQDDcsdLWv2tXzE2-me-zIy03M9gsLcmXzqK6VEHq1CtpovREFBJ5HppSfs6xR9dTX0iRb93MxhUt96ZCoMKnWvpiytPtHewZDiQJodjzGO73Ba9PYPV-rAJMbNDzrdCqC-FdSF_czNU-6Nv3?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales documents)

- Create proposals and quotes.
- Send contracts for signature.
- Document templates.
- Payment and CRM integrations.

Indicative pricing: from around £15–£20 per user/month.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

- Excellent PDF functionality.

## My recommendation

| Your requirement | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Cheapest straightforward solution | Signable |
| Best all-round platform | DocuSign |
| Easiest to use | Dropbox Sign |
| Proposals, quotes and contracts | PandaDoc |
| PDF-heavy business | Adobe Sign |


One important consideration for UK businesses: check that your provider supplies a suitable audit trail, signer authentication and tamper-evident signed documents. Electronic signatures are generally legally recognised in England and Wales, although some documents have additional requirements.
